dct_description_sm: This data set will be developed as a component of a large multi-disciplinary integrated IPY project to address climate variability and change (CVC) effects on Arctic char (PI J. Reist).  Chars are pivotal indicators of change in northern aquatic ecosystems and this study is one of three test cases (the others are Makivik Community Project and Labrador Char Long-term Monitory) to bring together scientific and local technical knowledge to develop approaches for monitoring of CVC effects on char biodiversity for wider deployment.
dct_title_s: Climate Variability and Change (CVC) Effects on Char in the Arctic - Sachs Harbour Community-based Monitoring of Arctic Char
